Checking authenticator.go line 180 to see if the PAT async worker is started by the server.

Only the s3presign runner is explicitly started by the server in server.go. Webhook workers launch via init() when the package loads, but they are event-driven goroutines processing an asyncPostQueue channel rather than scheduled runners. The PAT usage recording in authenticator.go is a fire-and-forget goroutine, not a scheduled runner. The SSE hub is not a background worker started by the server.

The memopayload runner exists but is not started by the server; RebuildMemoPayload runs inline from CreateMemo and UpdateMemo. The internal/scheduler package is also unused by the server.

I am examining which background runners the server actually starts.

The s3presign runner starts in server.go and runs once at startup, then ticks every 12 hours. Four webhook dispatch workers launch via the webhook package init() on import, triggered by PostAsync channel events. I am weighing whether these init-started workers count as server-started runners.

Only the s3presign runner is explicitly started by the server in startBackgroundRunners. The memopayload runner is not launched by the server. The internal scheduler is unused. Per-request async goroutines, the Echo HTTP server, and SSE heartbeat tickers are not global background runners.

memopayload.Runner is unused; only its inline RebuildMemoPayload logic is invoked. The internal/scheduler cron package is also unused.

message.text:
The scheduler is only used in its own package tests and examples. The server does not use it.

The server explicitly starts the s3presign runner once on startup and again on a 12-hour ticker. Webhook async workers launch as goroutines during package initialization, triggered by a channel queue on PostAsync. Whether these webhook workers count as server-started runners is unclear because they initialize outside server.startBackgroundRunners.

Only the s3presign runner is explicitly started by the server. The four webhook async workers run inside the server process because the server imports the webhook package, but they are launched by the Go runtime during package initialization rather than by the server itself.

memopayload.Runner is never started; only RebuildMemoPayload runs inline. The HTTP server goroutine and signal handler are not background runners. The answer will list only the explicit server-started runners and any other background workers that run alongside the server.
